## Task: Create DevelopRenderer composing progress indicator and agent grid
## Step: execute

Replace the placeholder DevelopRenderer from T18. Create DevelopRenderer.tsx and .css in web/src/renderers/develop/.

Import: type { WorkflowRendererProps } from '../types'; { registerRenderer } from '../registry'; { buildDevelopState } from './types'; { ProgressIndicator } from './ProgressIndicator'; { AgentGrid } from './AgentGrid'; import './DevelopRenderer.css'.

function DevelopRenderer({ runState }: WorkflowRendererProps):
const state = buildDevelopState(runState);
Return: div.develop-renderer containing ProgressIndicator with state.phases, then div.develop-content containing (optional phase label showing currentPhase), then AgentGrid with state.agents.

At module level: registerRenderer('develop', DevelopRenderer); — this registers the renderer so the app can find it.

Export { DevelopRenderer }.

DevelopRenderer.css:
.develop-renderer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
.develop-content { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; padding: var(--engin-space-sm); gap: var(--engin-space-sm); }
.develop-phase-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--engin-text-muted); padding: 0 var(--engin-space-sm); font-family: var(--engin-font-mono); flex-shrink: 0; }

Verification: cd web && bunx tsc --noEmit passes. bun run build:web succeeds.

## Relevant Files
web/src/renderers/develop/DevelopRenderer.tsx
web/src/renderers/develop/DevelopRenderer.css
